title: feat(cli): os validate, os build and os lint report manifest dependency ranges at build (ADR-0141 D2 author side)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLnF1puMxyuL977oxW4JUtt)_
Fixes #25793

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os validate`、`os build`、`os lint` 在构建时检查 manifest 的 `dependencies` 版本范围：写错语法的范围、以及同一个发布包内模块声明的范围与兄弟包实际版本对不上，都会当场报出来。
- **为什么改**：以前作者第一次听说这类问题，是别人的环境里安装被拒（422）；包内版本对不上则根本没人报。现在在构建时就能看到，HotCRM 拆模块时最先受益。
- **风险与回滚**：只会让 `os build` 拒绝「安装时无论如何都会被拒」的范围（包外依赖写了读不懂的范围）；包内的不一致只警告、不拒绝。读范围用的是安装门同一个函数，没有第二套解析。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/cli/src/utils/dependency-range-check.ts`（严重度如何跟随安装判定，`diagnosticOf`）；② 同目录测试里「the errors are exactly what the install door refuses」一组；③ `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` 的 3b-quater 步。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/dependency-range-doors.test.ts`，预期 5 个测试全过：读不懂的包外范围让 validate/build 退出 1，包内版本不符只出现在 warnings。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

ADR-0141 D2's author-side rule (Execution plan item 2). A new `packages/cli/src/utils/dependency-range-check.ts`, beside `checkProtocolVersionGap`, judges every `manifest.dependencies` entry of the packages one install act would deliver: each `packages[]` body of an ADR-0130 artifact, or the top-level manifest of a single package. That is the selection the artifact install door hands the same predicate (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`); an artifact's wrapper manifest is not judged, there or here.

**The reader is `checkDeclaredDependencies` from `@objectstack/metadata-core`** (with `DEPENDENCY_RANGE_GRAMMAR` for the message text). Nothing re-parses the grammar, and metadata-core is unchanged. Each delivered package is handed to the predicate alone, with its siblings standing in for the registry. A sibling then reads as "installed at its declared `manifest.version`", so the predicate's own `out-of-range` arm is the in-artifact mismatch and its `unreadable-range` arm is the unreadable range. Its `absent` arm, an out-of-artifact entry, is dropped: the target environment is not visible to a build.

Severity follows the install's own verdict:

| Finding | Install verdict | Here |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `dependency-range-unreadable`, entry outside the artifact | refused in every environment (fail closed) | **error**: validate and build exit 1; lint error |
| `dependency-declaration-unreadable` (not a record; reachable on lint's unparsed tier) | refused | **error** |
| `dependency-range-unmet-in-artifact` (sibling version outside the range) | admitted (presence only) | warning |
| `dependency-range-unreadable`, co-delivered entry | admitted (presence only) | warning |
| `dependency-version-unreadable-in-artifact` (sibling version not `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) | admitted | warning |

So `os build` refuses nothing the platform would install, which is what keeps `Clause-②: no` honest. The warnings ride `warningsSoFar()` in `validate.ts` and `compile.ts` (appended last, like the nav and permission-set lists) and are not in `--strict`'s list. `os lint` maps them by severity, so `os lint --strict` fails on them.

Wiring: `validate.ts` step 3e, `compile.ts` step 3b-quater, `lint.ts` beside the protocol-range check in `lintConfig`. `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` gets the `checkDependencyRanges` row in `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES` (it is cross-package by construction, so it cannot be a registry rule) and `formatDependencyRangeDiagnostic` under presentation.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/utils/dependency-range-check.test.ts` (unit, 15 tests). Arm 1: out-of-artifact error with path and grammar, single-package error, co-delivered warning, every grammar form readable. Arm 2: core 2.0.0 against `^1.0.0` is a warning naming both sides, silent when met in either package order, sibling prerelease version is a version-side warning, a readable out-of-artifact entry is not judged. **Install-door agreement** (seat 1's ask): four stacks are fed to `checkDeclaredDependencies` exactly as the artifact install door calls it against an empty environment, and the environment-independent refusals (`unreadable-range`, `unreadable-declaration`) must equal this check's errors.
- `packages/cli/test/dependency-range-doors.test.ts` (integration tier, 5 tests): two-package `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` projects spawned through the source CLI. Unreadable range: `os validate --json` and `os build --json` exit 1 with the entry in `errors`. Mismatch: `os validate --json` exits 0 with it in `warnings`, and `os lint --json` has a warning at `packages[1].manifest.dependencies["com.acme.core"]`. Control: no dependency finding.

## Acceptance notes

- The card says both doors judge "the ADR-0130 D4 union fold". The check reads `packages[]` bodies directly, the install door's own reading. The union fold flattens collections, not manifests, so it carries no per-package `dependencies` to judge.
- `os build` gained an exit-1 path. It fires only for an artifact the install refuses in every environment.
- Out of scope, as the card states: whether an out-of-artifact dependency is installed or in range stays the install check's.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the behaviour the tests pin)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/utils/dependency-range-check.ts --anchor "severity: inArtifact ? 'warning' : 'error'," --replacement "severity: 'warning',"` over the unit file at 8f126e6f. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob from 6da446f5da80 to a6cf785ecc76. **3 failed | 12 passed**: both arm-1 error tests and "agrees on an unreadable out-of-artifact range". The tool's own check confirmed the restore: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The CLI tests import `src/`, so no `dist/` leg applies.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- Dependency closure `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0 at d93a2217, after one TS2352 fix in the door test.
- `vitest run --project unit` (whole cli unit tier): 336 of 338 files passed. The two red files, `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`, failed only because `packages/cli/dist` was not built. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` they pass (2 files, 29 tests).
- Integration: `dependency-range-doors.test.ts`, 5 of 5 passed. The rest of the integration tier is left to CI.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 7 changed source and test files: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 62 families) run serially, reconciled with `--ran`: 57 exit 0. 5 are NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite: a full build or a pinned fixture commit): `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`. CI runs them. The run began at 8f126e6f. d93a2217 changes only a type cast in the door test.
- Full dogfood: not run. The title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint passes on the changed files (repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the maintainer brief, which the repo's rules ask for in Chinese.
